highlights: One Vercel application with platform control and tenant workspaces
Removed the unintended Marktone internal CRM workspace
Tenant CRM remains a module inside each tenant workspace
Introduced a clean database foundation independent from the failed legacy implementation
Moved authentication and workspace snapshots to isolated v2 RPCs
Added lint, type checking, tests, and build validation
Provision a tenant with its owner, plan, modules, and domain in one transaction
Invite and activate tenant users without exposing an administrative Supabase key
Created Reef Skills Training Center as the first active tenant on the full plan
Added a tenant-scoped staff directory with eleven real initial profiles
Added the Academy course catalog with six Reef training programs
Added full-plan entitlements for all current modules and unlimited users and courses
